core_problem_solved: To provide a framework for creating mock objects for interfaces and classes in Java, enabling unit testing of objects in isolation from their dependencies.
key_features: A dynamic mocking framework (no need to write mock classes by hand)
Pioneered the 'record-replay-verify' pattern for setting and verifying expectations on mocks
era_and_niche: A pioneering and highly popular dynamic mocking framework in the mid-to-late 2000s, which was a significant improvement over classic, manual mocking and a direct competitor to JMock.
reason_for_obsolescence: This is a **legacy library**. Its 'record-replay-verify' paradigm has been almost entirely superseded by the more flexible and readable 'stubbing' approach (`when(...).thenReturn(...)`) of **`org.mockito:mockito-core`**. Mockito is now the de facto industry standard for mocking in Java.
